name: Whimsical
label: Whimsical API (beta, read-only)
description: Whimsical API (beta, read-only) via OfficialApiNode (nodes/whimsical/api_spec.json). Official Whimsical API is limited beta, read-only, OAuth 2.1, support approval required. Catalog card_create/card_update are not on the published surface — omitted. Endpoints are RPC-style POST. Official docs: https://whimsical.com/learn/integrations/api. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Whimsical official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"board_get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'board_get', 'board_list', 'users_get', 'teams_list', 'comments_list'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'board_get'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: File or user id. board_get / users_get. Example: a Whimsical file id.

schema.label: parentId
schema.description: Parent folder id for board_list. Omit for the workspace root.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: board_get, board_list, users_get, teams_list, comments_list. Default: board_get. Example: board_get.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
